aso_writer_example.note: Example data: an invented habit tracker app from an invented studio, with invented rival apps, store results, Apple Ads export and search volumes, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json aso_writer_example follows from this input.
aso_writer_example.request: Hey Claude, I just added the "app-growth-audit" skill. Find the App Store and Google Play keywords my habit tracker can realistically win, pick the right categories and rewrite every listing field within the limits. Here is my subtitle, keyword field, promotional text, our Apple Ads search terms export and a few ideas.

app.name: Example Habits
app.what_it_does: A habit tracker: daily check-ins, streaks, routines (a morning routine, for example) with reminders, goals, a habit calendar and a weekly chart. Mood notes and a water count with its own reminder are optional add-ons. No timers, no smoking or diet programs.

app_store.name: Example Habits
app_store.subtitle: Build better routines
app_store.source: name and category from apple-store lookup_by_id; subtitle, keyword field and promotional text pasted by the user (not public)

google_play.title: Example Habits
google_play.short_description: The best habit app to build routines and keep streaks going
